walkthroughs.body_html:
Performance Characteristics Of Materials — a core area of A-Level Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Performance Characteristics Of Materials brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Performance Characteristics Of Materials.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between ductility and malleability?
options: Producing one unique item.

Ductility is for metals, malleability is for plastics.
